definition: The turning effect of a force about a pivot: the force times the perpendicular distance between the pivot and the line of the force, measured in N m.
When an object is in equilibrium, the clockwise moments about any point add up to the same total as the anticlockwise moments about that point.
The state of an object with no resultant force and no resultant moment on it, so its motion does not change: a balanced beam at rest stays still and does not start to turn.
